description: Checks Huawei Cloud real-name verification status and guides face-scan verification read-only through hcloud. Use for Huawei Cloud verification status, real-name onboarding, or flows blocked on verification. Accepts no identity documents, bank details, or SMS codes; refuses writes and non-Huawei-Cloud identity workflows.
